name: @pipeworx/mcp-entso-e

tools.name: day_ahead_prices
tools.description: Day-ahead auction prices (€/MWh) per hour for a bidding zone. Period is YYYYMMDDHHmm format (UTC).

tools.name: actual_load
tools.description: Measured electricity consumption per hour for a bidding zone (MW).

tools.name: actual_generation_per_type
tools.description: Actual generation per production type (solar, wind, nuclear, gas, ...) per hour.

tools.name: cross_border_flow
tools.description: Physical flow across an interconnector (in_area → out_area).

tools.name: installed_capacity
tools.description: Year-end installed generation capacity by production type (MW).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-entso-e forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the entso-e pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
